revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Reading by Gonis is good. Fine.
Vote - AcceptText - Fine. Then, => <:προβάτων=PN N. Gonis (image)|ed|προ.2των:> (καταβρώματος προβάτων is a common expression).
Submit - changes have now been encoded.

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - Yes, the reading looks good. It looks as if the beta may have been written over another letter as a correction. We encode this in the following manner: <:ἀπὸ καταβρόμα̣23.- [τος]=PN U. Yiftach (digital image)|ed|ἀπὸ καλα.2ομ.1 23.- .3:>. That way the original reading is put into the apparatus and you are credited with the correction via PN. Here are the instructions in the guidlines: http://papyri.info/docs/leiden_plus#pnpe-correction. Sending this back to you so that you can enter it correctly.
Submit - line 26: τὰς ἀρούρας ἀπὸ καταβρόμα̣[τος] (l. καταβρωμα̣[τος]) instead of τὰς ἀρούρας ἀπὸ καλα. .ομ. See picture. Comapre P.Kron. 34 l. 32.
Commit - line 26: τὰς ἀρούρας ἀπὸ καταβρόμα̣[τος] instead of τὰς ἀρούρας ἀπὸ καλα. .ομ.
